verdict.rationale: The Comptroller exposes a keyless, machine-readable Socrata JSON rail for open datasets such as franchise tax permit holders. It also documents EDI as an electronic filing channel for high-volume businesses. However, the core Webfile transactions (filing, payment, extensions, address changes, account status) exist only behind an authenticated eSystems UI session, and no public API spec was found. Missing for 10: any documented API for Webfile filing and payment, API coverage of account-management actions (extensions, certificates, address/location changes), a published OpenAPI or developer documentation, and evidence of overall UI-to-API parity.
